full_judgment: 3. In the absence of the defendant the suit was heard ex parte on 22-3-83 and the plaintiff examined three witnesses in support of his case. The trial Court, however, disbelieved the amalnama Ext.1 to be genuine document and the alleged date of knowledge regarding wrong recording of the suit land in the relevant SA Khatian and thereby dismissed the suit holding, inter alia, that Ext.1 Amalnema is a false, ante-dated and collusive document, by which plaintiff did not acquire any right, title and interest in the suit and the suit is also barred by limitation having not been filed within six years from the date of preparation of the record of right.
